items.text: In government, cut the yearly ceiling on refugees resettled from abroad from 125,000 to 7,500, later raised to 17,500.
In government, moved to end temporary protection from removal, with work permits, for people from 13 countries, about 1.1 million people, about 0.3 percent of the population.

Its national platform, adopted before this period, pledges to remove people without legal status in large numbers, finish the border wall, halt releases of people who crossed unlawfully, end family-based immigration beyond the immediate family in favor of merit, and cut national funding to local governments that limit cooperation with immigration enforcement.
